summary: Space reconcile's full passes and fault delivery by ten times their own last wall time, capped at 30 and 10 minutes

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: A fleet whose full pass is slow evaluates unmarked items, and delivers faults, less often; a small fleet keeps the one-minute and 30-second intervals.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the previous behaviour; nothing is stored.
